headline.title: AI chipmaker Groq confirms $650M raise, re-staffs after Nvidia’s $20B not-acqui-hire deal
headline.summary: AI chipmaker Groq has confirmed a $650 million funding round as it re-staffs following Nvidia's $20 billion not-acqui-hire deal. The company is focusing on expanding its neocloud business and bringing in new executives to support its growth.

articles.title: Three things to watch amid Anthropic’s latest feud with the government
articles.summary: Anthropic is currently in conflict with the US government regarding its AI model, Mythos, which was announced in April. The article outlines three key aspects to monitor as the situation develops.

articles.title: Google DeepMind bets $75M on AI’s future in Hollywood with A24 deal
articles.summary: Google DeepMind has partnered with A24 in a $75 million deal to develop AI filmmaking tools. This collaboration aims to enhance the creative process in Hollywood through advanced artificial intelligence technologies.

articles.title: The AI world is getting ‘loopy’
articles.summary: The article discusses the emergence of "loopy" AI systems, which involve a swarm of agentic AI agents that operate continuously in the background. This development represents a significant advancement in AI capabilities, allowing for ongoing autonomous operations.

articles.title: Meta Pauses Employee-Tracking Program Following Internal Data Leak
articles.summary: Meta has paused its employee-tracking program after an internal data leak exposed potentially sensitive information. The decision follows concerns about the security and privacy of the data involved in the initiative.

articles.title: Meta Exposed Data Internally From Its Controversial Employee-Tracking Program
articles.summary: Meta has revealed that it internally exposed data from its employee-tracking program, which collects keystroke data to train AI models. This initiative has faced criticism from employees who raised concerns about privacy and surveillance.

articles.title: Following user outcry, AMD reinstates memory encryption in consumer CPUs
articles.summary: AMD has decided to reinstate memory encryption features in its consumer CPUs after receiving significant backlash from users. The initial removal of this feature was perceived by critics as a strategy to push consumers towards more expensive chip options.

articles.title: Nvidia wants to cut data center water use, but that’s not the same as fixing AI’s water problem
articles.summary: Nvidia has introduced a new cooling system designed to reduce water consumption within data centers. However, this initiative does not tackle the significant water usage associated with fossil fuel power plants that support AI operations.

articles.title: Daybreak: Tools for securing every organization in the world
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched Daybreak tools, featuring Codex Security and GPT-5.5-Cyber, designed to assist organizations in identifying, validating, and patching vulnerabilities efficiently. These tools aim to enhance cybersecurity measures across various sectors.

articles.title: Patch the Planet: a Daybreak initiative to support open source maintainers
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched "Patch the Planet," a Daybreak initiative aimed at assisting open-source maintainers in identifying, validating, and addressing vulnerabilities using AI and expert reviews. The program seeks to enhance the security and reliability of open-source software projects.

articles.title: Amazon is testing Alexa+ in India with Hindi support
articles.summary: Amazon is testing its new conversational AI assistant, Alexa+, in India, offering a version that supports the Hindi language. The company is inviting users in the country to participate in the testing phase.

articles.title: SpaceX inks compute deal with Reflection AI, an open source AI lab
articles.summary: SpaceX has signed a contract with Reflection AI for $150 million per month starting July 1, 2026, to provide access to Nvidia's GB300 AI chips and related hardware at its Colossus 2 data center in Tennessee. The deal will extend through 2029, supporting Reflection AI's open-source AI initiatives.
